Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian rollout kickoff / connectivity orientation

Kerry / team —

Thanks for confirming Redwood for your private deployment. We'd like to kick off the connectivity and on‑prem rollout planning so we can hit the target turnup in July. High level agenda for this thread / first sync: 

- Confirm CIDR ranges and any conflicting subnets we should avoid
- VPC peering vs PrivateLink preference and peering account IDs
- Private endpoint hostnames and TLS cert model (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed)
- On‑prem package install window and access method (SSH jump / bastion / local console)
- HSM/KMS placement and any additional compliance constraints

Attachments: meridian_vpc_diagram.pdf (PDF, 124KB) — rough network topology we prepared.

Please reply with the CIDR blocks and preferred peering account, and flag any blackout windows for your infra teams. Kimberly and Monica will follow up with a technical checklist and an implementation cadence once we have these basics.

Thanks —
Rishi

Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Kerry O'Neill <kerry.oneill@meridianthera.com>, IT Ops <it@meridianthera.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian rollout kickoff / connectivity orientation

Kerry —

Quick technical checklist to help you collate answers. I left short notes where we have a recommendation.

1) CIDR and peering
   - Customer VPC CIDRs (required)
   - Preferred peering account ID (if using AWS peering) or service owner for PrivateLink
   - Recommendation: peering for low-latency; PrivateLink if you need strict egress control

2) Routing & NAT
   - Do you plan to route all egress through a central NAT? If so, provide route table IDs and NAT gateway IPs.

3) Ports / protocols
   - Outbound: 443 to Redwood control plane (we can provide IP ranges); 22/3389 only if you require remote package install
   - Inbound: none expected to the Redwood-managed endpoints; private endpoints will resolve inside your VPC

4) TLS / certs
   - Are you providing TLS certs for private endpoints (yes/no)? If yes, cert format and rotation cadence.

5) On‑prem package
   - Installer type: appliance (OVF) or package (rpm/deb).
   - Maintenance window: suggested 2–4 hour window for package install + validation.

6) HSM / KMS
   - HSM needed? If yes, provide vendor and connectivity model (on-prem HSM vs cloud KMS).

Attachments: redwood_onprem_install_instructions_v1.2.pdf (PDF, 320KB) — includes our recommended ports and preflight checks.

If you can share the CIDR and whether you want us to open a temporary SSH access (jump host) for install, we will schedule the on‑prem package drop. Monica will coordinate scheduling and runbook ownership.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Kerry O'Neill <kerry.oneill@meridianthera.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: IT Ops <it@meridianthera.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@meridianthera.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Meridian rollout kickoff / connectivity orientation

Rishi / Kimberly —

Thanks — good checklist. Answers below (TL;DR at top).

TL;DR: CIDR blocks and peering account details below; we prefer peering (latency sensitive). We can provide certs (customer-managed). Available for a 30-minute sync tomorrow 11:00 ET.

Details: 
- CIDR: 10.10.0.0/16 (prod), 10.11.0.0/16 (staging)
- Peering account ID: 987654321012
- NAT: Central egress via NAT gateway in prod us-east-1 (route table rtb-0a1b2c3d)
- Ports: OK for outbound 443 to Redwood public control plane IPs; will open 22 for short window on installer day (we will close after verification)
- TLS: We will provide certs (standard PEM chain). Rotation cadence: annual, internal rotation team handles updates — will provide contact.
- On‑prem package: We will take the RPM package. Preferred install window: Thu 17 Jun 2026, 00:00–04:00 UTC.
- HSM: Not required for MVP; will revisit for encryption‑at‑rest keys in Q4.

Attachments: meridian_infra_inventory.xlsx (Excel, 48KB) — contains asset list and VM console contacts.

One question: What is Redwood's recommended approach to certificate rotation for private endpoints? Do you support an ACME-style automation or will this require manual uploads to the console? Also, can you confirm the DocuSign SOW link? I received a link but wanted to confirm the version we should sign.

-Kerry
Kerry O'Neill
Head of Infrastructure, Meridian Therapeutics
kerry.oneill@meridianthera.com | +1 (617) 555-0104
